commit.message: feat(dcp): add ownership verification and release-one adapters

execution.stacked_because: TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0014 loopback ingress is merged on main (PR #1060).

invariants: Port presence alone never verifies ownership.
Ownership verification never sets callable true by itself.
Release-one allows only ConPort list/get decision and dope-memory search/replay.
Progress, broad query, writes, dope-context, task-orchestrator, and bridge remain blocked.
Tests inject HTTP transports; no live network, tunnel, or credential is required.

pr.body: Implements TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0015: fail-closed ownership verification (no port-only trust) and release-one safe adapters for ConPort decisions and dope-memory search/replay. No live backends, tunnels, writes, or non-release families.
pr.title: feat(dcp): add ownership verification and release-one adapters

steps.task: Implement pure ownership evidence adjudication with fail-closed matrix for wrong project, ambiguous, stale, unlabeled, protocol, mount, and port-only cases.
validation: Happy-path evidence with labels, roots, mounts, and protocol_ok verifies without callable true.

steps.task: Gate ConPort decision list/read and dope-memory search/replay behind verified ownership; deny progress/writes.
validation: Allowed ops require verified ownership and use injected transport only.

steps.task: Run focused/full tests, packet schema validation, pre-commit, advisory AGY, open PR without merge.
validation: Trusted embedded audit not claimed from AGY.

target: Implement fail-closed ownership verification and release-one safe adapters for ConPort decision list/read and dope-memory search/replay without live backends, writes, or non-release families.
